---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a scoped product or developer-workflow improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What user or maintainer problem needs solving?

## Proposed outcome

Describe observable behavior and acceptance criteria, without prescribing unnecessary architecture.

## MVP alignment

Explain whether this improves correct local chess play, rules coverage, feedback, or safe local
development. Multiplayer and elaborate animation remain outside the current milestone.

## Validation

List the focused tests and local commands that should prove completion.

## Cost and services

Confirm the proposal needs no paid service, external account, CI, or GitHub Actions. If it does,
explain why it should be deferred under `AGENT_READINESS_PREFERENCES.md`.
